title: Kernel allowed `.2` projection of an existential's proof component
summary: The kernel accepted the primitive projection `(_ : ∃ x, p).2`, a large elimination from a Prop whose inferred type does not even type-check in general. A route to False. Pre-stable; fixed in two Feb–Mar 2022 commits: Leonardo de Moura added the missing `infer_proj` check, and Gabriel Ebner then rejected the projection outright.

links.label: Fix commit (missing check at infer_proj, Leonardo de Moura)
Fix commit (reject (_ : ∃ x, p).2, Gabriel Ebner)
